provider_version_evidence.basis: The producer identifies DT-2024 as the November 2024 reprocessing, its new global 1/8-degree dataset, and its global CNES-CLS2022 MDT. The acquired NetCDF identifies the matching 202411 dataset version. This resolves the version at product-documentation level; the NetCDF itself does not state the MDT version.
provider_version_evidence.metadata_correction: The GRIIDC landing page cites the 008_057 climate-product PUM. The original NetCDF identifies 008_047 all-satellite product; use the matching 008_047 producer documentation, not the linked climate-product manual.

published_method_evidence.basis: Daily spatial mean is removed over 99–80 W and 17–31 N, then 17 cm contours are used for LC/LCE fronts. The study uses CNES-CLS22 MDT with a 1/4-degree grid; this pilot uses the pinned 1/8-degree product, so exact reproduction is not claimed.
published_method_evidence.incomplete_reporting: The paper does not state weighting in the spatial mean. Arithmetic finite-ocean gridpoint mean is the explicit OSW primary; cosine-latitude weighting is retained as a separate diagnostic.

operator_contract.closure: Exact library CLOSEPOLY and repeated endpoint, never reconstructed.
metrics: EW bounding arc at bounding-box midlatitude
operator_contract.uncertainty: Level and mean-method sensitivity only. Grid effects, MDT/mapping errors, temporal aliasing and physical front error are not quantified.
operator_contract.identity: Candidate IDs restart per date and scenario. No automatic name, across-level correspondence or track inference.
